description: For a media production company, a strong visual portfolio is paramount for attracting creative professionals like Ethan. Placing a showreel or a curated gallery prominently on the homepage allows users to quickly assess the quality and style of work without needing to navigate deeper, enhancing immediate engagement and trust.
spec: Implement a dedicated, auto-playing video showreel section or a dynamic image gallery (e.g., a carousel of project highlights) above the 'What we offer' section on the homepage. The showreel should be easily discoverable and visually engaging, potentially with a 'Watch Full Portfolio' call-to-action linking to a dedicated portfolio page.
title: Prominent Homepage Showreel/Portfolio
